title: Canvas Common Rules
description: Move this file outside the package to ../_shared/rules.json and every canvas there picks up the same rules automatically.

rules.title: Separate canvas and frame input ownership
rules.statement: In board and comment mode the canvas owns pan/zoom; in run mode the HTML frame owns its internal interaction.
rules.rationale: Prevents input conflicts between canvas navigation and running the screen.

checks: In comment mode, a wheel over a frame pans the canvas.
In run mode, scroll, hover and click work inside the frame.
